svg.font-family: 'Comic Sans MS', 'Chalkboard SE', 'Comic Neue', 'Bradley Hand', casual, sans-serif
svg.title: Biasing: tx_bias and the other bias pins
svg.desc: tx_bias takes the 0.6 V reference vref, the enable tx_en and the 1.25 V supply vddo, and gives tx_pgood. It sinks six tail currents from pam4_driver. MSB path, 10.67 mA: pre 0.53 mA, main 8.53 mA, post 1.60 mA. LSB path, 5.33 mA: pre 0.27 mA, main 4.27 mA, post 0.80 mA. 16 mA in total. A seventh output, i_pdrv for the pre-drivers, is not connected. The other bias and reference pins: vctrl sets the gain of vga, vtt is the reference of rx_term, vdd is the 0.7 V core supply and vddo the 1.25 V supply of the transmitter output stage. There is no receiver bias block yet, and threshold_dac is not instantiated.

g.text: Biasing: tx_bias and the other bias pins
tx_bias is the only bias block today. Each green bar is one tail current, as thick as its share of the 16 mA.

text.tspan: 5.33 mA, half of the MSB path
pre-driver tail current: not connected. predriver_cml has no bias pin yet.

g.text: 16 mA in total. Into 25 Ω that is 0.4 V peak, so 0.8 V peak-to-peak differential on txp / txn.
In each path the three currents are 0.05, 0.80 and 0.15 of that path: the FFE weights of pre, main and post.
The other bias and reference pins
threshold_dac is not instantiated yet: the DFE model drives the slicer references
CMOS on one side, CML on the other
